sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MathVision: Qwen3.8-27B is evaluated using the fixed prompt: "Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed {}." For the remaining models, we report the higher score from two prompt variants—one with and one without the \boxed {} formatting requirement.

sources.title: ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B: the same answers, 37% less thinking
sources.snippet: The second model in our ThinkingCap series. We took Qwen3.8-27B and cut how much it thinks, without changing the quality of the answers.

sources.title: BottleCap AI Releases ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B: 37.2% Fewer Thinking ...
sources.snippet: BottleCap AI has released ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B, the second model in its ThinkingCap series. It is a fine-tune of the Qwen team's Qwen3.8-27B with one narrow goal: shorter reasoning traces. Across 12 benchmarks, it spends 37.2% fewer thinking tokens on average.
